notes.title: Patch 1.07 - Touch Ups for Summer Pirate Gaming Parties!
notes.content:
Polished Host and Server List UI
Small Performance Increase
A Few Bug Fixes

Happy Summer Gaming,
Sweetbeard 🏴‍☠️🌞

notes.title: Patch 1.06 - New Gamemodes!
notes.content:
Added new Game Modes! Mix and match them to create the perfect chaotic pirate showdown for you and your friends. The team with the highest score when time runs out wins the match.

Team Deathmatch – Take out enemies to earn points for your team. Win fights, win points.

Bounty Hunt – Random players become high-value targets for a limited time. Take them out to receive bonus points before the opportunity vanishes.

Treasure Hunt – Search the map for treasure, hide it on your team's side to score, and defend it from rival pirates.

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - Gameplay Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Cannon Crates Are Now Hookshootable.
[*] Cannonball Knockback Timer Has Been Lowered From 5 to 3 Seconds.
[*] Cannonball Knockback Force Has Been Slightly Lowered.
[*] Added a Player Despawn Effect.
[*] Melee Swing Effect Changed to a Less Glowing Effect.
[*] Fixed Shooting Cannon Down Into the Ground — It Won’t Miss Anymore.
[*] Fixed So Player Can’t Pick Up Treasure While Being in Prison.
[*] Fixed So Player Can’t Ping While Being in Prison.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04 - GUI Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Volume Buttons Have Been Replaced With Volume Sliders.
[*] Aim Sensitivity Button Has Been Replaced With an Aim Sensitivity Slider.
[*] Added Settings Menu Button to In-Game Menu.
[*] Text Size Has Been Adjusted at Some Locations to Support All Languages.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Huge Swimming and AI Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Swimming Experience Has Been Significantly Improved; Much Less Stuttering.
[*] Bots Are Now Much More Responsive.
[*] Bots Engage in Sword Fights More Effectively.
[*] Bots Are Better at Capturing Enemies.
[*] Bots Have Improved Aiming Accuracy.
[*] Bots Freeze Much Less Frequently.
[*] Player Now Has a Unique Team-Colored Minimap Icon.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Swimming Improvements: Swimming and jumping out of water has been significantly improved
[*] Bot Accuracy: Bots now fire cannons with greater accuracy
[*] Bot Navigation: Bots can now get in and out of water more easily
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Minimap Update: Added a unique color to represent the player on the minimap for improved visibility.
[*] Friend Game Invite: Remade the friend game invitation list in to a pop-up for better functionality.
[*] Cannonball Fix: Fixed an issue where cannonballs would one-shot players on the second hit.


[*] Next: Improve swimming experience.
[/list]
